@@U02924@@
This gentlest of learned men resembles a charcoal burner, his face black from ears to nose, and his eyes red from puffing at the flame. He hangs on to every moment. The clang of his tongs is music to his ears.

@@U02926@@
But why should he reject me? I’m the very one to hasten his success.

@@U02927@@
(Exit the FAMULUS. 梅菲斯特 seats himself solemnly.)

@@U02928@@
No sooner have I taken up my post than I see a guest stirring back there, familiar to me, to be sure, except this time with a Bachelor's degree, and cheekier than is good for him, I dare say.

@@U02930@@
(Storming down the corridor.)

@@U02931@@
What’s this? Doors and gates thrown wide open? About time, too! Let in some air! Let us breathe for a change, rather than stifle in this decay, living like corpses, rotting, wasting away in this moldy heap of rubbish! These walls are leaning and sagging, about to collapse, and either I get out of here fast or be buried by them. I risk as much as the next, but no one’s dragging me farther into this house. But wait. Yes, I’ve been here before! I have! Years ago. I was a freshman.
translation:
@@U02924@@
这个最温和的学者就像一个烧炭的人，他的脸从耳朵到鼻子都是黑色的，眼睛被火焰熏得通红。他抓住每一个时刻。他的钳子发出的叮当声对他来说就像音乐。

@@U02926@@
但他为什么要拒绝我呢？我就是那个加速他成功的人。

@@U02927@@
（法穆勒斯下。梅菲斯特庄严地坐下。）

@@U02928@@
我一上任，就看到一位客人在后面活跃起来，当然，我很熟悉，除了这次拥有学士学位，而且我敢说，他的厚颜无耻对他来说是没有好处的。

@@U02930@@
（冲过走廊。）

@@U02931@@
这是什么？门和大门全开？也到时候了！让一些空气进来！让我们呼吸改变，而不是在这腐烂中窒息，像尸体一样活着，腐烂，在这发霉的垃圾堆里消瘦！这些墙壁倾斜、下垂，即将倒塌，我要么赶紧离开这里，要么被它们埋掉。我和下一个一样冒着同样的风险，但没有人把我拖进这所房子。但是等等。是的，我以前来过这里！我有！几年前。我当时是一年级新生。
